table.name: TLGNC_CONTAINER
table.description: Containers in this table are always silo-containers, i.e. are used for bulk transport of cement. Bag-Containers (such as containers used on ships) are not supported in the current release. Crh currently knows two types of containers, which are mainly distinguished by the position of their unloading pipes (see container_type). A container can be loaded at a normal loadingpoint when located on a truck/trailer/wagon. Unloading at a shipto happens similar to unloading a truck: the container returns with the same truck immediately after unloading the material. The special feature of containers are in combination with container terminals: a full container can be removed from a rail-wagon, maybe temporarily stored, and then loaded on a truck suitable to transport containers. An empty container can be loaded on the wagon and returned to a plant, where it's loaded with cement again.

column.name: CARRIER_ID
column.description: FK tlgnc_carrier. The carrier (in German: Transporteur, Spediteur, Lieferant) who owns the container.

column.name: ACTIVE_FLAG
column.description: 0=inactive/deleted, 1=active.

column.name: CONTAINER_NO
column.description: Business identifier (unique) of the container, i.e. inventory number as printed on the container but without formatting. Example: HOLU-745 502-2 is stored as HOLU7455022.

column.name: CONTAINER_NAME
column.description: Name of the container as displayed in the UI (with formatting). This is typically a shortened form of container_no, but must also be unique because it's used for display/selection in Logon. Example: HOLU-502.

column.name: CONTAINER_TRSP_CAT_CD
column.description: FK tlgnr_container_trsp_cat_bs. Transporting category of the container, i.e. what packaging type of material it can transport. Currently, only Silo (for Bulk).

column.name: CONTAINER_TYPE_CD
column.description: FK tlgnr_container_type_bs. The type of a container characterizes its unloading facilities: 1 = unloading horizontally (unloading pipes at its side), 2=unloading only when tilted (unloading pipes at back). The containers loaded on trucks/trailers are all of type 2 and all trucks/trailers used for those containers have tilting facilities. The 'horizontal' containers are used as fix-installed containers on rail wagons (currently, for NEAT construction sites).

column.name: UIC_PROFILE
column.description: UIC PROFILE. This is a text code without any logic for Login. Example (only value till now): C23.

column.name: LENGTH_FT
column.description: Length of the container in feet.

column.name: WIDTH_MM
column.description: Width of the container in mm.

column.name: HEIGHT_MM
column.description: Height of the container in mm.

column.name: TARE_WEIGHT_T
column.description: Weight of the empty container in tons. Typically this is measured in steps of 10kg.

column.name: VOLUME_M3
column.description: Loading volume of the container in cubic meters.

column.name: MAX_NET_WEIGHT_T
column.description: Maximal net weight.

column.name: MANUFACTURER
column.description: Manufacturer of the container. Has only informative character for the carrier and is ignored by Logon.

column.name: BRANDING_FLAG
column.description: 0=no, 1=yes, null=unkown/does not matter. Has only informative character for the carrier and is ignored by Logon.

column.name: CONTAINER_COMMENT
column.description: Comment about the container.

column.name: HOMEBASE_COORD_LAT
column.description: Latitude of the homebase of the container.

column.name: HOMEBASE_COORD_LON
column.description: Longitute of the homebase of the container.

column.name: RFIDOBJECT_ID
column.description: The ID which is used to associate this object (container) with RFID tags. An RFID object can have several RFID tags.

column.name: CURRENT_TRUCK_ID
column.description: FK tlgnc_truck. The Truck on which the container is currently loaded, or null if not on a truck. If on a trailer, and that trailer is connected to a truck, BOTH fields should be set.

column.name: CURRENT_TRAILER_ID
column.description: FK tlgnc_trailer. The Trailer on which the container is currently loaded, or null, if not on a trailer.

column.name: CURRENT_WAGON_ID
column.description: FK tlgnc_wagon. The Wagon on which the container is currently loaded, or null, if not on a wagon.

column.name: LAST_KNOWN_SHIPPINGPOINT_ID
column.description: FK tlgnc_shippingpoint. The shippingpoint where the container was last seen. Represents the current posistion of the container if the container is not an a truck or a wagon. If the container is on a truck or a wagon, then the position of the truck or the wagon is a more accurate description of the container's current position.

column.name: ARRIVAL_LAST_KNOWN_SP_DAT
column.description: Date/Time of the arrival at the last_known_shippingpoint_id. NULL is only allowed when the shippingpoint is also null (unknown).
